## Content
<!---  specific tasks that are currently complete

-->
Creates a global `init_params()` method under src/Common/initial_condition.jl that uses the appropriate model (Jouan et al. 2020 or Shipway & Hill 2012) based on the keyword argument under the --init_sounding argument. "Jouan" for initial conditions based on the interpolated sounding, and "ShipwayHill" or none specified as it is the default option.
